dedupe_keys.name: postal services network in the kingdom by postal regions

description: Postal Services Network in the Kingdom, by Postal Regions is a dataset listed in KAPSARC Data Portal, an energy economics open data portal, published or maintained by King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC). This dataset contains Saudi Arabia Postal Services Network in the kingdom, by Postal Regions for 2007-2019. Data from General Authority for Statistics. Export API data for more datasets to advance energy economics research. Notes: - Jeddah Postal Region was annexed to Makkah Postal Region as of 1415 A.H. Coverage: as titled: Saudi Arabia, the Gulf states, India or the world (see the dataset page). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are Postal, Post Office, Mail, Money Transfer, Postal Agencies. The portal shows 2022-07-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public Domain. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy, water and transport system studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kapsarc-open-data-portal.
